Saxophonist Ernie Watts was born in Norfolk, Virginia on October 23, 1945. He has performed with Buddy Rich, Jean Luc Ponty, the Rolling Stones and the Tonight Show Orchestra. Ernie’s identifiable sound kept him in demand as a first-call studio musician in Los Angeles. He currently leads his own ensembles and records with JVC Records.
Ernie was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 11, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto at the IAJE conference. I’m really pleased to have saxophonist Ernie Watts as my guest today, and I appreciate your taking your time out.
